title: Jester of the Abyss
description: A flamboyant jester in green and blue spiked armor with a blue cape and jester hat crouches on a wooden pier, one hand extended toward a stone prison window where ghostly figures reach out. To the left, a massive purple swirling vortex in the orange sunset sky sucks in floating fast food items while five silhouetted figures in top hats stand watching.
prompt: A dramatic surreal scene at sunset on a wooden pier over dark water. A colorful jester in green and blue spiked armor with pink hair and jester hat crouches dramatically, reaching toward a stone prison wall where pale ghostly prisoners reach through the bars. A massive purple swirling vortex in the sky pulls in floating burgers, french fries, and soda cups. Five mysterious silhouetted men in top hats stand on the pier watching. Blue magical spikes glow on the wet wood, smoke and embers fill the air, cinematic fantasy style.
